Title: Memory Provenance Dropped in run()
Description: BaseAgent.run() dropped memory provenance in context allowing poisoned memory to bypass MemoryQuarantine
Remediation: Added _extract_memory_provenance and forwarded in run() and stream()

Title: Missing import re in base.py
Description: stream() used re.findall() without module-level import re causing NameError
Remediation: Added import re at top of base.py

Title: PowerShell UTF-16LE Base64 Bypass
Description: Normalizer only decoded utf-8 base64 ignoring PowerShell UTF-16LE encoded commands
Remediation: Added utf-16le decoding and null byte stripping

Title: Airgap Bypass in arxiv_search
Description: arxiv_search queried export.arxiv.org under OFFLINE_AIRGAP mode

Title: WAN Egress in LOCAL_SERVICES
Description: scrapling_scrape did not enforce loopback under LOCAL_SERVICES

Title: get_active_memories missing on MemoryManager
Description: context_engine called get_active_memories which failed silently with AttributeError

Title: Provenance Key Taxonomy Mismatch
Description: PROVENANCE_WEIGHTS used explicit_user while guardian used user_explicit
Remediation: Aligned both keys to 1.00 in all dictionaries

Title: VisionAgent Keystroke & Hotkey Bypass
Description: evaluate_screen_action did not inspect command typing or system shortcuts
Remediation: Added command evaluation and system shortcut challenges

Title: Missing Any import in guardian.py
Description: arguments: dict[str Any] triggered runtime introspection failure under PEP 649

Title: Self-Codebase Overwrite in validate_safe_path
Description: parents[5] allows file_write to overwrite repository source code
Remediation: Restrict _get_allowed_roots strictly to DOCUMENTS_DIR and workspace

Title: Host Shell Execution Without Sandbox
Description: shell_execute executes directly on host OS without network/disk containment
Remediation: Enforce containerization or WFP network isolation

Title: Unbound WAL Context in Standalone Chat
Description: current_wal returns None during direct REPL chats leaving writes unlogged

Title: Unauthenticated operator_confirmed Bypass
Description: operator_confirmed is a raw boolean dictionary key without signature verification
